points.description: States a conclusion supported by the data, e.g. plastic B is the most stretchable / stretched the most (22 mm and 23 mm), or gives the correct ranking of stretchability.

Describes one valid improvement to experimental design/validity, e.g. using plastic samples of the same size and thickness, applying the same mass/weight to each sample, or keeping relevant conditions such as temperature the same.
Describes a second valid improvement to experimental design/validity, e.g. carrying out more trials and calculating an average for each plastic type, or using a more precise measuring method.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a data-based conclusion plus two distinct valid improvements. One mark is awarded for each correct point; equivalent wording and other valid improvements not listed but consistent with good experimental design should be accepted. No marks are awarded for vague statements that do not identify a conclusion or a specific improvement.
